scope: Opt-in per-request PLE mmap, staging-copy, and H2D telemetry

amdahl.C: not applicable; this unit adds measurement rather than a candidate route
amdahl.exception: negligible-risk instrumentation unblocks higher-impact P9 owner ranking
amdahl.overlap_exclusions: gather/dequant, staging copy, and H2D counters are nested in complete request wall and must not be added to profiled kernel buckets; telemetry-enabled wall is excluded from performance evidence
amdahl.strict_fallback: telemetry is opt-in and disabled by default

workload: canonical code-p512, warm PLE cache advice, one production request with 512-token prefill and 128 decode transitions
command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 uv run python scripts/qwen4exp_canonical_ar_bench.py hipengine --model-root /models/gguf/unsloth-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-UD-Q4_K_XL/UD-Q4_K_XL --fixture benchmarks/fixtures/qwen4exp_canonical_ar_p512_p1024_p4096.json --output /tmp/qwen4exp-p9-ple-telemetry-smoke-final.json --case-id code-p512 --ple-cache-mode warm --ple-telemetry --warmups 0 --repetitions 1 --prefill-chunk-size 512
decision: Close the instrumentation prerequisite only. The diagnostic identifies sparse page locality and ranks gather/dequant above staging copy and H2D, but its instrumented timing is not a speed claim.
